name: AppBar
purpose: Provide semantic header structure with start, center, and end regions without inventing navigation or toolbar behavior.
useWhen: A page or application header needs stable start, center, and end structural regions.

avoidWhen.condition: A group of controls needs arrow-key navigation.

composition: Compose AppBar.Root > AppBar.Toolbar > AppBar.Start, AppBar.Center, and AppBar.End; place actual navigation or Toolbar primitives inside the structural sections.

rules.statement: Treat AppBar.Toolbar as structural layout, not an ARIA toolbar.
Name comparable header landmarks when more than one exists.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using AppBar.Toolbar to imply grouped-control keyboard behavior.
commonMistakes.correction: Compose Toolbar.Root for controls or NavList and NavigationMenu for navigation.

validation: Confirm the root header landmark is appropriate in its page context.
Confirm content remains in logical start, center, and end order at zoom and in RTL.
